notes.raw: * ''Shurikens'' blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]] still count as being hit for the reduced pass-through damage. * ''Razor Shuriken'' is special cased to not lock out [[File:Zed Living Shadow 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Living Shadow 2|An icon for Zed's ability Living Shadow 2]] [[Zed#Living Shadow 2|Living Shadow's]] recast during its cast time. ** Other abilities are locked out and buffered to cast after ''Razor Shuriken's'' cast time, as normal. * If '''Zed''' buffers an attack command during ''Razor Shuriken's'' cast time the attack will perform slower than if '''Zed''' had attacked after the cast time. ** The same does not happen if '''Zed''' recasts [[File:Zed Living Shadow 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Living Shadow 2|An icon for Zed's ability Living Shadow 2]] [[Zed#Living Shadow 2|Living Shadow]] during ''Razor Shuriken's'' cast time. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
Shurikens blocked by spell shield still count as being hit for the reduced pass-through damage.
Razor Shuriken is special cased to not lock out Living Shadow's recast during its cast time.
* Other abilities are locked out and buffered to cast after Razor Shuriken's cast time, as normal.
If Zed buffers an attack command during Razor Shuriken's cast time the attack will perform slower than if Zed had attacked after the cast time.
* The same does not happen if Zed recasts Living Shadow during Razor Shuriken's cast time.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
